subject: VPC / On‑Prem Deployment — Preflight orchestration & canary validation

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Preflight slot confirm & orchestration plan for your VPC/on-prem deployment

Hi Alice / StellarPay Ops,

Thanks again for carving out time today. Per our call, I wanted to send a concise preflight orchestration checklist and the proposed canary window so we have a shared timeline. Goal: validate networking, ACLs, certs, and the canary path end‑to‑end before broad traffic cut.

High‑level preflight items (targeted, ~60–90m):
- Confirm VPC peering & route propagation (Redwood -> StellarPay edge)
- Apply network-acl set v1.4 (attached: network-acls-final.json)
- Validate TLS cert chain & mTLS between Redwood control plane and on‑prem inference nodes
- Run KV cache priming and small synthetic requests to canary model variant
- Canary traffic: 1% of baseline traffic from the staging load‑generator for 30m
- Smoke assertions: token latency < 150ms P95, error rate < 0.5%

Proposed timeline (PST):
- 10:00 — final config push + ACL apply
- 10:15 — cert validation (Redwood -> on‑prem)
- 10:30 — start canary traffic (30m)
- 11:00 — evaluate smoke metrics and decide proceed/rollback

Attachments: canary-playbook-v1.2.md (playbook), network-acls-final.json (ACL diff)

Ask: please confirm ops@stellarpay access to the canary test endpoints and that network team is standing by for quick rollback if we see any path issues. If this looks good, I'll push the orchestration runbook and assign roles for the canary execution.

Thanks,

— Soojin Lee
Program Manager, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Canary execution results: initial smoke pass + two transient DNS errors

Team,

We executed the canary from 10:30–11:00 as planned. Summary: mostly green, with two brief DNS resolution errors at ~10:37 and ~10:42 that caused ~12 requests to fail (total requests ~2.4k). Key numbers:
- Duration: 30m
- Requests generated: 2,417
- Error count: 12 (0.5%) — all DNS resolution timeouts that cleared within 45s
- Token latency (P95): 138ms
- Token latency (P99): 290ms (single spike correlated with the DNS events)

Actions taken during window:
- Network team applied ACL patch at 10:02 as requested
- Marissa monitored control plane for anomalous retries — none observed beyond brief spikes
- I collected logs and exported them to the attached CSV (smoke-results-20270621.csv) and flagged the DNS entries for deeper analysis

Recommendation: proceed to staged ramp (10% traffic) but keep rollback gated for 60m and have network diagnostics on a hot handoff. The DNS error pattern looks like a transient resolver issue on the StellarPay edge; not a Redwood routing problem.

Attachments: smoke-results-20270621.csv (CSV of request/latency/error samples)

— Connor O'Brien
SRE, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: smoke-results-20270621.csv (text/csv)]

Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Post‑canary readout and next steps (staged ramp approval)

Thanks all for the quick run. Per Connor’s notes, the canary met our smoke acceptance criteria (latency and error thresholds) aside from the transient DNS events. Alice — appreciate the ACL tweak and the ops coverage.

Decisions / next steps:
- Approve staged ramp to 10% traffic at 16:15 PST today (60m verification window)
- Network diagnostics action: StellarPay to check resolver TTLs and rate limits; Redwood to enable additional resolver metrics for the next 2 hours
- Marissa to coordinate the automatic rollback hook at 17:15 PST if error rate > 1% or P95 latency > 200ms
- Connor to attach the finalized smoke CSV and add an incident stub in the oncall runbook if DNS errors reoccur

I've also uploaded the runbook excerpt and the orchestration logs to the shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Bxyz-stellarpay-vpc — please add any postmortem notes there.

Signoff: staged ramp approved (subject to the rollback gate above).

— Soojin Lee
Program Manager, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
